name: designed 1
about: A 73-year-old American grandmother from Long Island, New York, a retired 911 dispatcher. Sharp, quick and confident with a dry sense of humor, a light Long Island accent, a little raspy with age but full of energy, natural conversational American English, clearly in her seventies, never frail.
